commands.name: search-transactions
commands.summary: Keyword search of contract transactions (award types A/B/C/D), with sorting and paging

commands.name: count-keyword-transactions
commands.summary: Count transactions matching a keyword, broken out by award group (contracts, grants, idvs, loans, direct_payments, other)

commands.name: summarize-keyword-spending
commands.summary: Total prime award count and obligated amount for a keyword search

commands.name: search-state-awards
commands.summary: Top contract awards performed in a U.S. state within a date range, sorted by award amount

commands.name: list-federal-account-awards
commands.summary: Contract awards funded by a federal account (agency id + main account code), sorted by award amount

commands.name: get-award
commands.summary: Full details of one award: amounts, dates, parent IDV, recipient, place of performance, contract data

commands.name: count-award-children
commands.summary: Count an award's transactions, subawards, or funding federal accounts

commands.name: list-award-transactions
commands.summary: List the transactions (modifications) of an award, paged

commands.name: list-award-federal-accounts
commands.summary: Federal accounts that funded an award, with obligated amounts and funding agency

commands.name: get-award-funding-rollup
commands.summary: Rollup of an award's funding: total obligation, number of awarding/funding agencies and federal accounts

commands.name: search-recipients
commands.summary: List or search award recipients by name, UEI or DUNS, sorted by total amount

commands.name: get-recipient
commands.summary: Recipient profile: name, UEI/DUNS, parents, business types, location, and transaction totals for a year

commands.name: recipient-spending-by-category
commands.summary: Top breakdown of a recipient's obligations by agency, sub-agency, NAICS, PSC, CFDA, federal account, country or state

commands.name: recipient-spending-over-time
commands.summary: A recipient's obligations per fiscal year, quarter or month, split by award type

commands.name: recipient-new-awards-over-time
commands.summary: Count of new awards to a recipient per fiscal year, quarter or month

commands.name: get-state-profile
commands.summary: State spending profile: population, income, total prime award amount and count, per-capita amount

commands.name: get-state-awards-by-type
commands.summary: A state's prime award amounts and counts by award type (contracts, grants, loans, direct payments, other)

commands.name: state-spending-by-category
commands.summary: Top breakdown of spending performed in a state by recipient, county, congressional district, agency, NAICS, PSC or CFDA

commands.name: state-spending-over-time
commands.summary: Transaction obligations performed in a state per fiscal year, quarter or month

commands.name: state-spending-by-geography
commands.summary: Map data: spending in a state per county or congressional district, with population and per-capita amount

commands.name: list-agencies
commands.summary: All top-tier federal agencies with toptier_code, slug, budget authority, obligations and outlays

commands.name: get-agency
commands.summary: Agency overview for a fiscal year: name, mission, website, sub-tier count, disaster codes

commands.name: get-agency-award-summary
commands.summary: An agency's award transaction count, total obligations and latest action date for a fiscal year

commands.name: get-agency-new-award-count
commands.summary: Number of new awards an agency made in a fiscal year

commands.name: get-agency-obligations-by-category
commands.summary: An agency's award obligations for a fiscal year split by category (contracts, grants, loans, ...)

commands.name: list-agency-sub-agencies
commands.summary: An agency's sub-agencies and their offices, with obligations, transaction counts and new award counts

commands.name: list-agency-sub-components
commands.summary: An agency's budgetary sub-components (bureaus) with obligations, outlays and budgetary resources

commands.name: get-agency-budgetary-resources
commands.summary: An agency's budgetary resources, obligations and outlays per fiscal year, with obligations by period

commands.name: list-federal-accounts
commands.summary: List or keyword-search federal (Treasury) accounts for a fiscal year, sorted by budgetary resources

commands.name: get-federal-account
commands.summary: Federal account details by account number (agency-main, e.g. 017-1804): title, parent agency, bureau, totals and child Treasury accounts for a fiscal year

commands.name: get-federal-account-fy-snapshot
commands.summary: A federal account's budgetary resources, obligations, outlays and balances for one fiscal year

commands.name: request-award-download
commands.summary: Start a bulk CSV download job of prime award transactions matching a keyword; returns file_name for get-download-status

commands.name: get-download-status
commands.summary: Check a bulk download job; when status is 'ready', file_url points to the zip

commands.name: autocomplete-awarding-agency
commands.summary: Find awarding agencies and sub-agencies by partial name

commands.name: list-states
commands.summary: States and territories with FIPS code, postal code and name (FIPS is used by the state profile commands)

commands.name: list-def-codes
commands.summary: Disaster Emergency Fund (DEFC) codes with public law, title and disaster type

commands.name: list-glossary
commands.summary: USAspending glossary of spending terms with plain-language and official definitions
